description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camel case and title case formats. It is intended for use across the application's UI components to ensure consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens as delimiters, collapsing multiple whitespace, and trimming. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, normalizing delimiters and spacing, handling apostrophes and accented characters, and preserving original value if not a string.
